name: moss-skills
description: Compatibility manifest for the Moss skills Codex app plugin package.

interface.shortDescription: Moss skills for writing guidelines, notes, formulas, variables, links, frontmatter, comments, canvas, and HTML previews.
interface.longDescription: Compatibility manifest for direct root installs. The Codex app package lives at ./plugins/moss-skills and includes the Moss note skills from this repository.
defaultPrompt: Create a Moss product analysis note under ~/Moss/Notes for this feature, with goals, requirements, open questions, and a focused moss-html prototype that demonstrates the core interaction.
Turn this rough UI idea into a Moss product analysis note with frontmatter, decision notes, and separate small moss-html previews for the main states.
Review this Moss product analysis note for broken wiki links, comments/frontmatter issues, and whether its embedded moss-html prototype matches the described behavior.
